Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE finished premium original fantasy collectible card game IN-GAME SCREENSHOT for the existing game LORE. Landscape 16:9, 2560x1440 desired. Full bleed single playable screen, no device, no collage, no concept title, no exterior annotation. Craftsmanship comparable to major competitive digital TCGs, original interface and artwork.
CRITICAL: preserve this game's actual rules and information, do not invent systems. Exactly TWO players. Fixed market EXACTLY EIGHT face-up cards and offered market EXACTLY FOUR face-up cards; BOTH MARKETS must be together at the spatial CENTER of the overall screen, permanently visible, clearly separated and labeled "固定マーケット" and "提示マーケット · あなた". Fixed stock badges respectively ×3 ×2 ×3 ×1 ×3 ×2 ×3 ×3. Offered cards no stock badges. Each market card has a small mana purchase price (fixed 1,2,2,3,3,4,5,6; offer 2,3,4,6), identifiable dark fantasy art and a simple card-type mark. Refresh control attached only to offered market "更新 1". One subtle small watch indicator on one fixed card. No shopping currency, gold counter or marketplace filters.
Comparable illustrative midgame state: Your HP 32/40, mana 6/8, hand EXACTLY FIVE face-up portrait cards including a blue attune crystal and an old treasure chest; opponent HP 28/45, mana 3/7, hand EXACTLY FOUR face-down cards with count 4. Turn 8, "あなたのターン". Current player end-turn button "ターン終了" with time 38 integrated beside it.
Your battlefield EXACTLY THREE monsters, stat pairs 4/5, 2/3, 3/4. Opponent battlefield EXACTLY THREE monsters, 3/4, 2/2, 4/6. One of yours subtly outlined blue as attack-ready, one spent unit desaturated. Each player has ONE face-down trap marker and ONE face-up persistent spell with duration "2" for opponent, infinity symbol for yours. Monster capacity SEVEN PER PLAYER; spell/trap COMBINED capacity SEVEN PER PLAYER. Show unobtrusive zone labels "モンスター 3/7" and "魔法・罠 2/7" for each player. Preserve left-to-right creature order, no lane combat implied. Small status keyword and counter chips only attached to affected card, e.g. "カウンター 1". Opponent trap identity never revealed.
Each player must have separate readable clickable pile counters "山札 12" (opponent 14), "墓地 5" (opponent 6), "除外 1" (opponent 2). Deck click is composition / own remaining cards, not new action. Each player one compact race-synergy strip "種族 2 · ✓2 · 3", no experience gauge. Keep own/opponent stats equally available. Profile portraits are identity only, NOT abilities.
Utility affordances: "ログ", "音量", "操作", "投了" small and quiet. Enlarged card rules, buy confirmation with mana price, targeting/cancel, deck/grave/exile browsing, discard/other choices and random-result panels are contextual overlays accessible from corresponding elements; do NOT open all overlays in this neutral screenshot. Do not add hero powers, attack-all, phase progress bars, special energy, equipment slots, quests, minimap, chat, emotes, ranking bar, currency, new buttons, extra units or extra markets. No generated logo; allocate screen space to gameplay.
Clean legible Japanese labels, strong number hierarchy, real card-game information design. Readability and count correctness over decoration. Rich original archive-themed illustration within the cards, subtle materials, restrained selection glow. Card faces and stats upright and readable to viewer. Keep markets and both battlefields unobscured.

concepts.title: 競技盤 — 判断の速さ
concepts.direction: DESIGN 1 — COMPETITIVE HORIZONTAL. An exceptionally polished matte obsidian/navy game board with ivory typography, cobalt self, muted crimson opponent. Camera strict top-down, no perspective. Broad quiet negative space. Opponent portrait and four card backs top center; opponent spell/trap markers then three rectangular art-cropped monsters above the market. ONE horizontal market ribbon centered precisely at y=50%: offered FOUR cards on left, fixed EIGHT on right, all twelve same readable size. A fine vertical divider separates the groups. Your three art-cropped monsters below ribbon, spell/trap markers behind them, self portrait and five-card gently overlapping hand at bottom. Piles at right of respective fields, synergies left. No empty slot outlines, only 3/7 and 2/7 counters. Thin gold structural line only, no ornate frame. End-turn on center right, utility text along top edge. The visual advantage is extremely fast scanning with large clean card art. Premium finished game screenshot, not wireframe.

concepts.title: 閲覧机 — 触って理解する
concepts.direction: DESIGN 2 — TACTILE ARCHIVE TABLE. A believable luxurious physical reading desk viewed straight down. Warm ivory parchment, black oak edge, aged brass, deep cobalt and oxblood ownership markers. The play surface consists of two broad facing manuscript reading mats, no grid. Monsters are illustrated physical cards on each mat; traps are SMALL SEALED BOOKMARKS in the separate spell/trap row, persistent spells are open paper leaves with exact duration counters. Centered horizontal brass library circulation tray: offered FOUR on left and fixed EIGHT on right, both visible in a single straight line, stock on tiny paper tags, refresh a functional stamped brass circular arrow. Player avatars in modest reading-lamp medallions with explicit HP and mana numeric plaques, no big flames obscuring UI. Deck is a bound chronicle, grave a paper stack, exile a slim torn archive folio; explicit normal Japanese pile labels and counts MUST accompany each, no cryptic symbolism alone. Your five-card hand bottom. Scene texture and cast shadows create richness, no unrelated decorative props, candles, dice, quills or clocks. End-turn is a simple ink-stamp press with a 38-second ring at center right. No empty slots. All utility labels present. This should feel physical and inviting, structurally quieter than typical ornate fantasy UI.

concepts.title: 中央書架 — 市場を軸に対戦
concepts.direction: DESIGN 3 — LEFT-VERSUS-RIGHT, VERTICAL MARKET SPINE. Radically different spatial organization. Clean graphic ivory stone and midnight ink, tiny red and cobalt details, editorial precision. YOUR field occupies LEFT half, OPPONENT field RIGHT half. A compact central vertical library panel occupying x=40–60% contains offered FOUR cards in a 2 by 2 grid ABOVE fixed EIGHT cards in a 2 by 4 grid. Thus all TWELVE market cards stay EXACTLY IN SCREEN CENTER, never sidebars. Two clear Japanese market headers with refresh beside offered header. Your three monster tiles in a HORIZONTAL ordered strip left of the market, your trap and enchant strip beneath; opponent same horizontal ordered strip right of market, two backrow markers beneath. No arrows or lane links; this is not lane combat. The left and right fields do not point at specific matching enemy creatures. Your avatar and stats near far left upper corner; opponent near far right upper corner. Your five-card hand along bottom LEFT, opponent four backs along top RIGHT. Pile trio and synergy near each field's outer edge. Zone counters clearly say 3/7 and 2/7. Your end-turn + timer at bottom of central spine without displacing market. Generous whitespace; art-rich card tiles; print-like typographic hierarchy, crisp flat surfaces, delicate embossed material, NOT a spreadsheet, no giant book prop. A highly usable original interface centered on shared economic decisions.

concepts.title: 召喚舞台 — カードの存在感
concepts.direction: DESIGN 4 — CINEMATIC SUMMONING STAGE. Original magical archive in blue-black nocturnal stone; card art is the spectacle. THREE opponent creatures and THREE self creatures appear as richly painted bust illustrations rising slightly above discrete low stone nameplates (NOT standalone extra creatures), each plate has the exact required stat pair and compact status marks. Their ordered rows are shallow wide arcs above and below the CENTER market, no circular lanes or targeting tracks. Subtle illusion of depth only in the background; all interactive card faces, text and numbers are orthographic/upright. Small sealed trap plaques and persistent-spell plaques form a clearly separate back row on each side; never merged with monsters. Both markets form a single well-lit floating horizontal manuscript shelf across exact screen center, offered FOUR on left, fixed EIGHT on right. All twelve remain equally legible, grounded to one thin center shelf, not orbiting. Player portrait at top and bottom, HP/mana adjacent, five-card hand bottom, enemy four backs top. Deck/grave/exile numeric seals at right of each player; synergies left. Use dramatic rim lighting inside six monster art crops, disciplined dark quiet negative space everywhere else, very restrained blue/amber lighting. No full-screen VFX or extra characters. No empty slots. The mood is an expensive card-battle game with visual presence, not a cinematic illustration lacking UI.

concepts.title: 白い整理盤 — ルールの見通し
concepts.direction: DESIGN 5 — EXPLICIT CAPACITY, BRIGHT PORCELAIN TACTICAL UI. Bright soft-white paper and porcelain interface with confident charcoal typography, dusty red opponent and cobalt self. FULLY VISIBLE exactly SEVEN small understated slots for each player's monster row AND SEVEN for each player's combined spell/trap row: FOUR rows total, 28 slots. Fill each monster row with THREE cards and leave FOUR quiet empty outlines. Fill each spell/trap row with ONE trap plus ONE spell and leave FIVE quiet outlines. Opponent spell/trap at y=17%, opponent monsters y=31%, centered market y=50%, your monsters y=67%, your spell/trap y=80%. Center market as a white recessed unified shelf: offered FOUR cards on left fixed EIGHT right, thin divider, clear headers above, 12 compact portrait art cards. Card art saturated and gorgeous against almost-white ground. Do not create any extra slot rows. Avatar/status bars compact top and bottom; hand of five face-up cards at bottom foreground without covering spell/trap row, enemy four backs top. Pile trio outside rows at right, synergy left. End-turn center right. Utility labels top edge. Empty outlines very faint so only occupied objects attract attention. This is a world-class bright competitive interface with architectural precision and immediately understandable capacity, no ornate wood/brass theme, no excessive boxes, no sci-fi holograms.
